name: DownloadFileFromBlobStorage
label: Download File from Blob Storage
description: Downloads a file from an Azure Blob container to a specified local path.

fields.name: BlobContainerClient
fields.label: Blob Container Client
fields.description: The BlobContainerClient instance used to download the blob.

fields.name: BlobName
fields.label: Blob Name
fields.description: The name of the blob/file in the container to be downloaded.

fields.name: SaveLocation
fields.label: Save Location
fields.description: The full path to the local folder where the file will be saved.

fields.name: DownloadedFilePath
fields.label: Downloaded File Path
fields.description: The full local path to the downloaded file.
